baseline_A_reopen_watch: Vendor evidence invalidates current main/rear spar OD, wall, tolerance, or splice-fit assumptions.
Vendor mass or layup changes make managed CG 0.75 m or aeroelastic closure infeasible.
y=3 m splice cannot be recovered by detail design, coupon, or local FEM without changing spar architecture.
claim_boundary: Draft vendor-screening pack only while mass/span authority is under repair; it is not purchase-ready, not supplier selection, not drawing release, and not final aircraft sign-off.

risk_register.engineering_read: Tube family evidence is a screening assumption. A real supplier miss can invalidate spar stiffness, mass, splice fit, and procurement schedule.
risk_register.trigger: Vendor cannot meet 100/98 main or 80/78 rear HM CFRP tube family with credible tolerance and layup data.

risk_register.engineering_read: The inboard splice only has zero screening bending margin after auto-sizing. This is the highest-priority vendor/detail question.
risk_register.trigger: Any vendor knockdown, ovality, fit tolerance, or wall variation makes y=3.0 m splice margin negative.

risk_register.engineering_read: Fit ambiguity can create contact peaks, bondline gaps, ovalization, and unmodeled local bearing.
risk_register.trigger: Vendor cannot state ID/OD/ovality/straightness tolerance or recommended diametral clearance for CFRP spigots.

risk_register.engineering_read: Changing laminate can move EI/GJ, local buckling, torsion, mass, and managed CG.
risk_register.trigger: Vendor proposes a layup, fiber modulus class, hoop fraction, or resin system materially different from the HM screening family.

risk_register.engineering_read: The splice design and release segmentation are built around the 3 m transport constraint.
risk_register.trigger: Vendor cannot ship/protect/inspect 3 m segments or requires a different maximum length.

risk_register.engineering_read: C04 and splice concepts depend on bond and contact repeatability, not only tube strength.
risk_register.trigger: Vendor finish or coating is incompatible with structural bonding, ferrules, saddle rings, or spigots.

risk_register.engineering_read: This can put sleeves, hard ribs, or cut lengths in the wrong place without changing any software test.
risk_register.trigger: Vendor or shop drawing mixes 3 m transport splice stations with materialized spar-joint rib stations or aero/rib tip extents.

risk_register.engineering_read: No traceability means vendor data cannot close the current coupon/local FEM readiness boundary.
risk_register.trigger: Vendor cannot provide certificates, batch traceability, dimensional report, same-batch coupons, or replacement policy.
